description: Shows the utilization thresholds that reject background operations before a capacity enters deep throttling.
notes: An unconfigured capacity returns state Disabled and omits both thresholds. Enabling an unconfigured capacity requires both thresholds in one update. Disabling clears persisted thresholds. rejectionThreshold is 15-100; recoveryThreshold is 6-99 and must be strictly lower.

query_examples.description: Check whether surge protection is enabled.
Read the rejection threshold when enabled.
